title: Marquise solitaire, 6-prong, hidden halo, micro-pavé shoulders, white gold (~3ct)
note_source_vs_listing: Source = vendor CAD renders (Drive folder 1HC3xULaK9BpCZiDRXddxJg_j5SEyaXA9), white metal, marquise 3.00ct: top face + two side views. Piece: a MARQUISE-cut centre diamond (pointed both ends, oriented north-south) in a 6-prong head (two V-tip prongs + two side-pair prongs); a HIDDEN HALO of tiny round accents encircles the marquise under the girdle (visible from the side/rear, not the top); the shank shoulders carry a single row of small round micro-PAVÉ diamonds (scallop/French-set) running about half-way down each side; thin white-gold shank, no taper. No visible surface halo, no second row.

scene.studio: premium plain pure-white velvet, soft natural folds, bright neutral-white daylight, no logo overlay
scene.lifestyle: worn on a real hand, natural skin, real environment per catalog theme, the piece is the hero
